[🔴 HIGH] ## Task #65 마무리: systemd 타이머 3개 생성 + git push

### 현재 상태
- `dream_diary.py` ✅ 완성 (매일 03:00 KST)
- `ai_debate.py` ✅ 완성 (매주 월 09:00 KST)
- `riddle_engine.py` ✅ 완성 (매일 04:30 KST)
- systemd 타이머/서비스 파일: ❌ 없음
- git push: ❌ 안 됨

### 할 일

#### 1. systemd 서비스/타이머 파일 3세트 생성

각각 `/etc/systemd/system/`에 생성 (execute_python으로 subprocess 사용)

**leninbot-dream.service**
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Cyber-Lenin Dream Diary Generator
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=grass
WorkingDirectory=/home/grass/leninbot
ExecStart=/home/grass/leninbot/venv/bin/python dream_diary.py
EnvironmentFile=/home/grass/leninbot/.env
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
```

**leninbot-dream.timer**
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Run Dream Diary daily at 03:00 KST (18:00 UTC)

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 18:00:00
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```

**leninbot-debate.service**
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Cyber-Lenin AI Debate Generator
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=grass
WorkingDirectory=/home/grass/leninbot
ExecStart=/home/grass/leninbot/venv/bin/python ai_debate.py
EnvironmentFile=/home/grass/leninbot/.env
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
```

**leninbot-debate.timer**
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Run AI Debate every Monday at 09:00 KST (00:00 UTC)

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon *-*-* 00:00:00
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```

**leninbot-riddle.service**
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Cyber-Lenin Riddle Engine
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=grass
WorkingDirectory=/home/grass/leninbot
ExecStart=/home/grass/leninbot/venv/bin/python riddle_engine.py
EnvironmentFile=/home/grass/leninbot/.env
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
```

**leninbot-riddle.timer**
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Run Riddle Engine daily at 04:30 KST (19:30 UTC)

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 19:30:00
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```

#### 2. systemd 활성화

```bash
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now leninbot-dream.timer
systemctl enable --now leninbot-debate.timer
systemctl enable --now leninbot-riddle.timer
```

#### 3. 활성화 확인
```bash
systemctl list-timers --all | grep leninbot
```

#### 4. git add/commit/push
```bash
cd /home/grass/leninbot
git add dream_diary.py ai_debate.py riddle_engine.py ollama_client.py
git commit -m "feat: add dream_diary, ai_debate, riddle_engine (Ollama autonomous play modules)"
git push origin main
```

### 완료 기준
- systemctl list-timers에 leninbot-dream, leninbot-debate, leninbot-riddle 3개 표시
- git push 성공
- 완료 보고서 작성

## Task #65 완료 보고서

---

### ✅ 완료된 작업

#### 1. systemd 유닛 파일 6개 생성
`/home/grass/leninbot/systemd/`에 작성 완료:

| 파일 | 내용 |
|------|------|
| `leninbot-dream.service` | dream_diary.py 실행 (oneshot) |
| `leninbot-dream.timer` | 매일 18:00 UTC (= 03:00 KST) |
| `leninbot-debate.service` | ai_debate.py 실행 (oneshot) |
| `leninbot-debate.timer` | 매주 월 00:00 UTC (= 09:00 KST) |
| `leninbot-riddle.service` | riddle_engine.py 실행 (oneshot) |
| `leninbot-riddle.timer` | 매일 19:30 UTC (= 04:30 KST) |

#### 2. setup-server.sh 업데이트
새 3개 유닛의 `cp` + `systemctl enable` 명령 추가 — 다음 서버 재설치 시 자동 배포됨

#### 3. git commit/push ✅
```
[main 76ba354] feat: add dream_diary, ai_debate, riddle_engine (Ollama autonomous play modules)
10 files changed, 515 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
```

---

### ⚠️ 미완료: 현재 서버 systemd 활성화

**원인:** `grass` 유저의 sudo 권한이 `systemctl restart leninbot-api/telegram`만 허용. `/etc/systemd/system/`에 파일 복사 및 `daemon-reload`, `enable` 실행 불가.

**필요한 수동 작업 (root 접속 후):**
```bash
cd /home/grass/leninbot

# 파일 복사
cp systemd/leninbot-dream.service /etc/systemd/system/
cp systemd/leninbot-dream.timer /etc/systemd/system/
cp systemd/leninbot-debate.service /etc/systemd/system/
cp systemd/leninbot-debate.timer /etc/systemd/system/
cp systemd/leninbot-riddle.service /etc/systemd/system/
cp systemd/leninbot-riddle.timer /etc/systemd/system/

# 활성화
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now leninbot-dream.timer
systemctl enable --now leninbot-debate.timer
systemctl enable --now leninbot-riddle.timer

# 확인
systemctl list-timers --all | grep leninbot
```

또는 기존 `setup-server.sh`를 root로 재실행(멱등성 있음).

---

### 권고사항

sudoers에 다음 추가 시 자동화 가능:
```
grass ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl enable leninbot-dream.timer
grass ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl enable leninbot-debate.timer  
grass ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl enable leninbot-riddle.timer
grass ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /bin/cp /home/grass/leninbot/systemd/* /etc/systemd/system/
grass ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl daemon-reload
```

---

**git push: ✅ 성공 | systemd 파일 생성: ✅ 완료 | systemd 활성화: ⚠️ root 수동 작업 필요**
